claims.verbatim:
Steamship Kangaroo (Br.), Manning, Liverpool July 12, with mdse.
nd 292[?] pass. to John G. Dale. July 14, 14 miles NE of Tuscar, passed
hip Jeremiah Thompson, from Liverpool for New-York; 17th, lat. 51
2[?], long. 22 08, steamship City of Dublin, bound E; 19th, lat. 50 36[?],
ong. 33 48, British bark Hornet, bound E; 21st, lat. 48 54, long. 44 11,
assed two icebergs; 22d, lat. 43[?] 15, long. 46 14, passed steamship
Cuba, bound E; same day, lat. 46[?] 03, long. 46 54, saw two large ice-
ergs; 25th, lat. 40[?] 24, long. 59 41, steamship Edinburgh, bound E;
8th, 85[?] miles East of Sandy Hook, passed steamship City of Paris,
ound E.

claims.claim: Spoken / sighted Fastnet 48 miles W of Fastnet (3d)
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Etna (Br.), Tibbits, Liverpool Aug. 1, via Queenstown
2d, with mdse. and 523 pass. to John G. Dale. Aug. 2, 45 miles W of
South Stack, exchanged night signals with steamship City of Cork,
bound in; same day, off Hook Tower, passed a National steamer,
bound up the channel; 3d, 48 miles W of Fastnet, saw steamship Ed-
inburgh, bound E; 12th, lat. 45 31, long. 55 12, a brig-rigged Cunard
steamer, bound E; 13th, lat. 42 23, long. 61 51, Bremen steamship
Hansa, bound E.
